args.title: Separate error toasts to use assertive aria-live and no auto-dismiss
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update ToastProvider and Toast component in src/components/Toast.tsx to separate error toasts so they use aria-live="assertive" and do not auto-dismiss after five seconds.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

src/components/Toast.tsx uses a single role="status" aria-live="polite" container with AUTO_DISMISS_MS = 5000 for all toasts including errors. We are updating the ToastProvider and Toast component in src/components/Toast.tsx to separate error toasts so they use aria-live="assertive" and do not auto-dismiss after five seconds.
